board.text: Lineup locks in 6:32 - Thu 8:15 PM: Drake London
Only 2 projection sources came in this hour (missing: FantasyPros, CBS, FFToday, Yahoo) - consensus is thinner than usual
Woody Marks (BN4, value 7.5/wk) - Upgrade (move 3): drop for RJ Harvey (+2.4/wk)

Waiver: worth a claim - Denzel Boston (WR, CLE, value 12.9/wk) - Values 8.8/wk above your weakest flex-eligible bench player; last 3 weeks 17.2 ppg; rising; takes the spot Jonathon Brooks frees (no drop needed, +12.8/wk) (also on 7 rival wish list(s))
Devin Singletary: 146,529 teams dropped him in the last day (rostered 10%). The crowd is bailing
League rosters are 76 h old - the Yahoo pull did not run

Timing only: Denzel Boston (WR) is the likely next pickup for Autumn, PJ, Madeline, Sophia, Kaden, Anna, Morgan and he values 10.0/wk above your weakest bench WR - worth claiming on his own merit; the rival interest just argues for doing it sooner
Week 5 bye: Harrison Butker - two waiver runs to find cover
